description:
## Why

Consumer pattern surfaced by PKIX-lwr9.4 / tc60 diagnosis: build_path() is a single-shot wrapper that returns only the first DFS candidate from build_path_candidates(). It has no SignatureVerifier dependency, so it cannot know in advance which candidates will fail signature checks. Adversarial pools (cross-signed graphs with mixed signature algorithms, expired alternatives, etc.) frequently require iterating candidates.

The current pattern forces every consumer to write the iteration loop themselves: pkix-difftest does it on the PKITS side (PKIX-t0w4) and will do it on the limbo side (PKIX-lwr9.4.1); downstream consumers face the same gap.

## What

Add to pkix-path-builder (signature subject to review during impl):

```rust
pub fn build_first_valid_path<V: SignatureVerifier>(
    target: &Certificate,
    pool: &[Certificate],
    anchors: &[TrustAnchor],
    policy: &ValidationPolicy,
    verifier: &V,
) -> Result<Vec<Certificate>, PathBuildError>;
```

Semantics:
1. Iterate build_path_candidates(target, pool, anchors).
2. For each candidate, run validate_path(candidate, anchors, policy, verifier).
3. Return Ok(chain) on first candidate that validates.
4. Return Err(PathBuildError::NoValidPath { tried: usize, last_error: ... }) when iterator is exhausted.

## Acceptance

- [ ] build_first_valid_path<V> exists in pkix-path-builder with the semantics above.
- [ ] Unit test: cross-signed pool with one valid + one invalid signature alternative; helper picks the valid one.
- [ ] Unit test: pool with no valid path returns NoValidPath with tried count.
- [ ] Rustdoc clearly distinguishes build_path (single-shot, no verifier), build_path_candidates (iterator, no verifier), build_first_valid_path (iterator + verifier, returns first valid).
- [ ] Existing build_path / build_path_candidates signatures unchanged (no breaking changes).
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry under pkix-path-builder.

## Relationship

Does NOT replace the PKIX-lwr9.4.1 harness fix. The harness fix is the immediate corpus-flip; this helper is the durable API ergonomics fix that downstream consumers can adopt. pkix-difftest may later adopt this helper internally, but that's a follow-up.

## Out of scope

- Async / parallel candidate evaluation.
- Caching of validate_path failures across candidates (each candidate is fresh).
- Promoting build_path itself to iterate (rejected as breaking change per PKIX-lwr9.4 diagnosis).

## Filed by

Split from PKIX-lwr9.4 after Mark chose 'both' (harness fix + helper API) 2026-05-11.
title: pkix-path-builder: add build_first_valid_path<V> helper (candidates + validate_path)
